info.title: Ultralytics Platform API
info.summary: Build, train, and deploy YOLO models with the Ultralytics Platform REST API.
info.description: The [Ultralytics Platform](https://platform.ultralytics.com) API lets you manage datasets, train models on cloud GPUs, deploy inference endpoints, and more — all from your own code. See the [Quickstart](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/quickstart) to get started.

externalDocs.description: Full documentation with guides and examples

tags.name: Datasets
tags.description: Create, browse, and manage labeled image datasets for training YOLO models. See [Datasets documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/data/datasets).

tags.name: Images
tags.description: Inspect, annotate, move, and delete dataset images by their unique image ID.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Organize your models into projects. Each model belongs to one project. See [Projects documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/train/projects).

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Manage trained YOLO models — view metrics, download weights, run inference, and export to other formats. See [Models documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/train/models).

tags.name: Training
tags.description: Launch YOLO training on cloud GPUs (RTX 4090, A100, H100) and monitor progress in real time. See [Cloud Training documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/train/cloud-training).

tags.name: Exports
tags.description: Convert models to optimized formats like ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML, and LiteRT for edge deployment. See [Deploy documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/deploy).

tags.name: Deployments
tags.description: Deploy models to dedicated inference endpoints with auto-scaling, health checks, and monitoring. See [Endpoints documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/deploy/endpoints).

tags.name: Storage Integrations
tags.description: Connect external cloud storage for dataset ingestion.

tags.name: Lifecycle
tags.description: Restore or permanently delete trashed projects, datasets, and models.

tags.name: Upload
tags.description: Upload files directly to cloud storage using signed URLs for fast, reliable transfers. See [Data documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/data).

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Inspect your Platform account, plan, credits, storage, and workspaces.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Inspect workspace credit transactions, plan status, limits, and usage.

post.description: Launches YOLO training on a cloud GPU. Training costs are deducted from your credit balance based on GPU type and duration.

captureDatasetVersion.description: Save an immutable dataset version for this run

model.description: Base model path or ul:// URI

lr0.description: Initial learning rate. Higher values (e.g. 0.01) train faster but may be unstable; lower values (e.g., 0.001) are safer but slower.

lrf.description: Final learning rate factor. Controls how fast learning is at the end of training. Lower values help the model fine-tune.

momentum.description: Controls how much past updates influence current optimization. Higher values (e.g. 0.9) speed up training but may overshoot.

weight_decay.description: L2 regularization to prevent overfitting. Higher values reduce complexity but may slow learning.

warmup_epochs.description: Gradually increases the learning rate over the first N epochs to stabilize training.

warmup_momentum.description: Gradually increases momentum during warmup to stabilize early training.

warmup_bias_lr.description: Learning rate for bias parameters during warmup phase to help stabilize early training.

optimizer.description: Optimization algorithm. Auto selects the best optimizer based on model and training setup.

box.description: Bounding box loss weight. Adjusts how localization errors impact training.

cls.description: Classification loss weight. Adjusts how class prediction errors contribute to total loss.

dfl.description: Distribution Focal Loss weight. Adjusts how much DFL impacts box regression accuracy.

pose.description: Pose loss weight (pose task only). Controls keypoint localization importance.

kobj.description: Keypoint objectness weight (pose task only). Controls keypoint visibility prediction.

hsv_h.description: HSV-Hue augmentation range for color variation.

hsv_s.description: HSV-Saturation augmentation range for color variation.

hsv_v.description: HSV-Value (brightness) augmentation range for lighting variation.

degrees.description: Image rotation range in degrees for augmentation.

translate.description: Image translation range (fraction of image size) for position augmentation.

scale.description: Image scaling range for size augmentation.

shear.description: Image shear range in degrees for shape augmentation.

perspective.description: Perspective transformation range for view augmentation.

mosaic.description: Probability of mosaic augmentation (combining 4 images into one).

mixup.description: Probability of mixup augmentation (blending two images).

copy_paste.description: Probability of copy-paste augmentation (segment task). Copies objects to new positions.

epochs.description: Total number of training epochs. More epochs allow the model to learn more but take longer.

batch.description: Batch size for training. Use -1 for auto-batch to fit available GPU memory, or set a fixed size.

imgsz.description: Input image size for training. Larger sizes improve accuracy but use more memory and time.

pretrained.description: Start from pretrained weights. Disable to keep the selected model architecture with random weights.

patience.description: Early stopping patience. Epochs to wait after no improvement before stopping. Lower values save time but risk early termination.

time.description: Training time limit in hours. Training stops after this time regardless of epochs.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Use 0 for random behavior.

deterministic.description: Ensures exact reproducibility by disabling GPU randomness. May slow down training.

amp.description: Mixed precision training (FP16 + FP32). Speeds up training and reduces memory usage on modern GPUs.

cos_lr.description: Cosine learning rate scheduler. Gradually reduces LR following a cosine curve for smoother training.

compile.description: Compile the model with torch.compile for faster training on modern GPUs after a slower first epoch. Also accepts a compile mode name (default, reduce-overhead, max-autotune, max-autotune-no-cudagraphs).

close_mosaic.description: Disable mosaic augmentation in final N epochs for better fine-tuning. Set 0 to keep always on.

save_period.description: Save checkpoint every N epochs. -1 saves only best and last.

fraction.description: Fraction of dataset to use for training (1.0 = full dataset).

freeze.description: Number of layers to freeze. Retains pretrained features. Use null to train all layers.

single_cls.description: Treat all classes as a single class. Useful for class-agnostic detection.

rect.description: Rectangular training. Reduces padding but may lower accuracy due to less randomization.

multi_scale.description: Multi-scale range as a fraction of imgsz. 0 disables, otherwise trains at varying sizes (max 0.9).

val.description: Run validation during training. Disable for faster training (not recommended).

resume.description: Resume training from a previous checkpoint.

device.description: Training device. Auto selects best available (CUDA > MPS > CPU).

cache.description: Dataset caching strategy. RAM is fastest but uses more memory. Disk is slower but saves RAM. False loads on-the-fly.

workers.description: Number of data loader workers for parallel loading.

dropout.description: Dropout rate for classification head regularization.

iou.description: IoU threshold for NMS during validation.

max_det.description: Maximum detections per image during inference.

404.description: Model, project, or dataset not found

409.description: Training already active or cancelled before start

client = Platform()  # Reads ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY

    train_args={"model": "yolo26n.pt", "data": "ul://jane-doe/datasets/coco8", "task": "detect", "classes": [1], "project": "example-project", "name": "example-name", "lr0": 0.01, "lrf": 0.01, "momentum": 0.937, "weight_decay": 0.0005, "warmup_epochs": 3, "warmup_momentum": 0.8, "warmup_bias_lr": 0.1, "optimizer": "auto", "box": 7.5, "cls": 0.5, "dfl": 1.5, "pose": 12, "kobj": 1, "hsv_h": 0.015, "hsv_s": 0.7, "hsv_v": 0.4, "degrees": 0, "translate": 0.1, "scale": 0.5, "shear": 0, "perspective": 0, "flipud": 0, "fliplr": 0.5, "mosaic": 1, "mixup": 0, "copy_paste": 0, "epochs": 1, "batch": -1, "imgsz": 640, "pretrained": True, "patience": 100, "time": 1, "seed": 0, "deterministic": True, "amp": True, "cos_lr": False, "compile": False, "close_mosaic": 10, "save_period": -1, "fraction": 1, "freeze": 1, "single_cls": False, "rect": False, "multi_scale": 0, "val": True, "resume": False, "device": "auto", "cache": "false", "workers": 8, "dropout": 0, "iou": 0.7, "max_det": 300},
)
print(response)
